units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כמין פ׳ שטחה לו וכ׳</he> she (Pharaoh’s daughter) spread over him (Solomon) a sort of baldachin in which were fixed precious stones &c.—Pl. <he>פָּרָסִין</he>. Y’lamd. to Num. XV, 37 quot. in Ar., v. <cite ref="S00909"><he>קִיטָּי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:1">Tosef. Bets. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>מעלה את פְּרָסוֹ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>כל שפרסוהו</he>) if one puts up his net on the eve of the Holy Day, and, coming in on the Holy Day, finds it disturbed.
